high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "radioactron." The post features a futuristic one-person electric vertical takeoff and landing (EVTOL) vehicle called iFLY. The text overlay on the image reads: "GLANCED THIS ONE-PERSON EVTOL COULD SOON BE YOUR EXCLUSIVE MODE OF TRANSPORTATION iFLY flies through the use of eight propellers and eight electric motors that run on batteries." The image itself shows a sleek, white, pod-like vehicle with a transparent dome-shaped cabin, positioned on a circular platform. The vehicle has eight propellers
